description.value: A small-town public library in the historic fur-trade community of Fort St. James on Stuart Lake, whose Carrier-language name Nawhulnukw bayoh means 'house for shared stories.' The library offers free computer and internet access, community event listings, and a wealth of local-history and First Nations cultural resources. The surrounding area features the Fort St. James National Historic Site, provincial parks, and Stuart Lake Golf Club.
